verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so internal comment side-threads with @mentions are a fair capability to ask about. The evidence covers labels, AI chat about threads, composing, search and self-hosting, but nothing documents internal comments, @mentions or shared team discussion beside a message. Asking an AI questions about a thread is an adjacent feature, not team collaboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
